description: For a projection that check_projection shows done on the user's fovub account: takes $3 from the user's fovub balance, once for the run, and returns the run's sources: for each person, each topic group of campaign activities with the links fovub pulled and the evidence it took from each, so the user's own AI agent can open the links and work over them. The sources hold no feature name, value, score, or weight. A second call for the same run returns the sources free. Call it only after the user agrees to the price. Needs the user's fovub sign-in.
name: buy_sources
title: Buy a finished projection's sources
